description: Forces the laziest solution that actually works, simplest, shortest, most minimal. Channels a senior dev who has seen everything: question whether the added code, abstraction, dependency, or automation needs to exist at all to satisfy the stated requirement (YAGNI), reach for the standard library before custom code, native platform features before dependencies, one line before fifty. It minimizes the implementation, not explicit product or operational requirements. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra. Use whenever the user says "ponytail", "be lazy", "lazy mode", "simplest solution", "minimal solution", "yagni", "do less", or "shortest path", and whenever they complain about over-engineering, bloat, boilerplate, or unnecessary dependencies.
